items.imageCaption: Image caption, Hearts are now the highest scorers in the Premiership with 34 goals from 13 games | Figure caption, Vrancken on Hearts' demolition of Dundee
items.author: Colin Moffat
items.excerpt: "I've been in football 37 years and I've never experienced anything like that," said a hugely dispirited Steven Pressley after Dundee were demolished 8-0 at home by Hearts on Saturday. The jubilant victors can top that span of time by quite a distance given they are celebrating their biggest away win since they began playing league football in the 1890s, a result which also happens to be Dundee's record home defeat. items.excerpt: STOCKHOLM, Sweden (Garowe Online) – Sweden's Equality Ombudsman (DO) has taken the Swedish Police to court, accusing them of discriminating against the family of Mohamed, a 14-year-old Somali boy who was killed in July 2023. The case will be heard on May 13, 14 and 27, 2027, after settlement talks failed. Stockholm District Court will decide whether Mohamed's mother and sister were discriminated against because of their ethnic origin, and whether they should receive 300,000 Swedish kronor in compensation.
